mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 2% from prior month), production bottlenecks reduce corporate output and margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines > 2% from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly non-farm payrolls growth falls below 50,000 (PAYEMS), it indicates a slowing labor market that reduces consumer income and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 50,000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a severe contraction in aggregate demand, which triggers a bearish sentiment in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and GDPC1 both decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% for two consecutive months), production capacity utilization falls, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
